scope: Six selected mod cases; source/schema/default/example/base evidence, not native engine-algorithm proof.

ActionAddGoodsToItemContainer.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionAddGoodsToItemContainer</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>Goods</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>Good</Name>
                      <NeededProperty>Product;Item</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>Amount</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>AddQuestID</Name>
                      <Description>Indicates whether the quest ID of this action should be added to the items (i.e. quest items)</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>SetGoodPoolLimitToAmount</Name>
                      <Description>This value only makes sense for AssetPools as Good. If false: Amount specifies the amount per good in that pool. If true: Amount specifies the total amount that may be transferred, probably leaving out some goods from the pool.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                  <Name>ItemContainerObjects</Name>
                  <Description>The objects in here need either PropertyItemContainer or PropertyDistributionCenter !</Description>
                  <AllowedTemplates>ObjectFilter</AllowedTemplates>
                  <AllowedProperties/>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>UseQuestAreaKontor</Name>
                  <Description>If true, the kontor of area where the quest originates is used as a target to add/remove goods</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionDeleteObjects.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionDeleteObjects</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShipsLeaveMapFirst</Name>
                  <Description>If true, all ships among the selected objects will leave the map before being destroyed</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionEndQuest.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionEndQuest</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Quest</DataType>
                  <Name>Quest</Name>
                  <NeededProperty>Quest</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>WinQuest</Name>
                  <Description>If true the quest ends successfully otherwise it is marked as failed.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>AbortQuestExceptionally</Name>
                  <Description>PLEASE HANDLE WITH CARE! Quests aborted this way will treat it as if it was internally aborted, see also https://confluence.ubisoft.com/display/anno7/Quest+Implementation+Guide for "Special Reason". If this flag is set, the flag "WinQuest" will be ignored</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionEnterSession.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionEnterSession</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>TargetSession</Name>
                  <Description>The session that should be entered. This session has to be loaded already!</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Session</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionExecuteScript.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionExecuteScript</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>FileName</DataType>
                  <Name>ScriptFileName</Name>
                  <Description>The script file that should be executed</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionForceNewspaper.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionForceNewspaper</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>Articles</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>Article</Name>
                      <NeededProperty>NewspaperArticle;NewspaperSpecialEditionArticle</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>OpenNewspaperUI</Name>
                  <Description>If set to true, we will open the newspaper UI as soon as the action was triggered</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>OpenNewspaperType</Name>
                  <Description>If openNewspaperUI set to true, this defines the type of newspaper scene that should be shown</Description>
                  <DataSet>ActionNewspaperType</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>EditorMessage</Name>
                  <Description>If a value is set, this message will be taken as editor welcome message in the newspaper scene. If nothing is set, the default message will be choosen</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>PamsyWelcomeRequiredAsset</Name>
                  <Description>An asset GUID that is needed to identify the correct reaction asset in the PamSy trigger: MenuWelcomeMessage</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShowPamsyMessage</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the editor should announce the new newspaper to the player</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionMoveObject.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionMoveObject</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>IgnoreEveryDistractionDuringMove</Name>
                  <Description>If true, the units won't get distracted by for example enemy ships and will move to their destination</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>UseDangerLayer</Name>
                  <Description>If true, the unit will avoid the danger based on the danger layer of its owning participant</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>SearchMode</Name>
                  <DataSet>ActionMoveSearchType</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionNotification.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionNotification</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>AutoCreateAsset</DataType>
                  <Name>Notification</Name>
                  <AllowedTemplates>SideNotification;CharacterNotification;MainNotification;OnScreenNotification;UplayNotification;BalancedNotification;CampaignNotification;AttractivenessNotification;AudioNotification</AllowedTemplates>
                  <AllowedProperties/>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>PerformIntegrityCheck</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the notification should only be triggered if the profile has been discovered/defeated/etc.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionPlayMovie.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionPlayMovie</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>Movie</Name>
                  <Description>Link to a movie asset that should be enqueued</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Video</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>SuppressGamePause</Name>
                  <Description>If true, the game will NOT be paused during the movie</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionRegisterTrigger.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionRegisterTrigger</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>TriggerAsset</Name>
                  <NeededProperty>Trigger</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>UnregisterTrigger</Name>
                  <Description>If false, the trigger will be created. CAUTION: If it is already created it will be reset to its origin state. If true, the trigger will be unregistered instead of registered</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>InheritArea</Name>
                  <Description>Set to true if you want the area by the paren Quest/Trigger to be passed on to the newly registered trigger</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionSetIslandName.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionSetIslandName</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>SessionIsland</Name>
                  <Description>The session in which the island can be located</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Session</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>IslandAsset</Name>
                  <Description>The asset of the island that should be renamed</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Text</DataType>
                  <Name>NewIslandName</Name>
                  <Description>The new name of the island</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>Text</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionSetObjectVisibility.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionSetObjectVisibility</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>Visibility</Name>
                  <Description>The new object visibility</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShowEffect</Name>
                  <Description>Show construction or deconstruction effect (after deconstruction, the object will be invisible forever)</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>EnableBlocking</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>AlsoSetGameLogic</Name>
                  <Description>If true the GameLogic of this object is set with the visibility. No visibility -> no GameLogic</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>EnableSounds</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>SuppressSettingVisibility</Name>
                  <Description>This action can affect more than just visibility, i.e. changing GameLogic state. If these effects are desired without a change of visibility, you should set this flag. Unfortunately we canno name it "ModifyVisibility" with a default value of TRUE because of savegame compatibility.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionSpawnObjects.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionSpawnObjects</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>SpawnGUID</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>Amount</Name>
                  <Min>1</Min>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>SpawnInfolayer</Name>
                  <Description>spawned objects will show this infolayer</Description>
                  <NeededProperty>InfoLayerIcon</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>Highlight</Name>
                  <Description>Highlights the spawn assets with an outline</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>String</DataType>
                  <Name>SpawnContextObjectLabel</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>RandomRotation</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>OwnerIsProcessingParticipant</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>Owner</Name>
                  <DataSet>ParticipantID</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>DoSetVisualSpawnOwner</Name>
                  <Description>If true, you will visually override the owner of the object, i.e. the object looks as if it belongs to a different player. If false, visual owner is the same as the real owner</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>VisualSpawnOwner</Name>
                  <Description>Visually override the owner of the object, i.e. the object looks as if it belongs to a different player. If false, visual owner is the same as the real owner</Description>
                  <DataSet>ParticipantID</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>String</DataType>
                  <Name>SpawnObjectGroupLabel</Name>
                  <Description>If a text is given the spawned object will be added to a group with the text as label. If the group did not exist before, it will be created</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

ActionUnlockAsset.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>ActionUnlockAsset</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>UnlockAssets</Name>
                  <Description>Assets get unlocked</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>Asset</Name>
                      <NeededProperty>Locked;AssetPool</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>UnhideAssets</Name>
                  <Description>Assets get visible</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>Asset</Name>
                      <NeededProperty>Locked;AssetPool</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>UnlockGroups</Name>
                  <Description>Assets in these groups get unlocked </Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>QuestGroup</DataType>
                      <Name>Group</Name>
                      <AssetConfig>AssetEditor</AssetConfig>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>UnhideGroups</Name>
                  <Description>Assets in these groups get visible</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>QuestGroup</DataType>
                      <Name>Group</Name>
                      <AssetConfig>AssetEditor</AssetConfig>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

AmbientMoodProvider.schema:
<Property>
        <Name>AmbientMoodProvider</Name>
        <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>AmbientMood</Name>
          <DataSet>AmbientMood</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>Murmur</Name>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>GlacierMurmur</Name>
          <Description>Replaces the default murmur if placed on a glacier island in the arctic</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>AttractivityDependentMurmur</Name>
          <Description>The Murmur with the highest reached Attractivity is added. (the attractiveness information is taken from this building directly, so e.g. for a zoo, museum or monument this makes sense)</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>Attractivity</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>Murmur</Name>
              <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>ProductivityDependentMurmur</Name>
          <Description>The Murmur with the highest reached Productivity is added.</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>Productivity</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>Murmur</Name>
              <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>ApplyMurmurAndMoodToModules</Name>
          <Description>if true the murmur for this building will also be applied to all it's Modules</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>DynamicEnvironmentType</Name>
          <Description>When this building is placed it replaces the environment sound with this environment.</Description>
          <DataSet>EnvironmentType</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>IslandAttractivityDependentMurmur</Name>
          <Description>The Murmur with the highest reached Attractivity is added. (the attractiveness information is taken from the whole island)</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>Attractivity</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>Murmur</Name>
              <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Array</DataType>
          <Name>HappinessDependentMurmur</Name>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
          <DataSet>HappinessState</DataSet>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Choice</DataType>
              <Name>Murmur</Name>
              <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>MonumentNoEventMurmur</Name>
          <DataSet>MurmurType</DataSet>
          <Description>Murmur that is used when this is a monument and has no event running</Description>
          <Category>AmbientMoodProvider - Murmur</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
      </Property>

Attackable.schema:
<Property>
        <Name>Attackable</Name>
        <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>AttackableType</Name>
          <Description>Can be empty! The type or role this attackable plays within the game rules that decide when it is attackable.</Description>
          <DataSet>AttackableType</DataSet>
          <AllowEmpty>1</AllowEmpty>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>MaximumHitPoints</Name>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>PausedTimeIfAttacked</Name>
          <Description>buildings get shutdown if under attack</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AlertRange</Name>
          <Description>If this attackable is attacked (or attacks) an enemy, it sends an alert to all ally units within this range. 0 = no alerts</Description>
          <Category>Attackable</Category>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>200</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>HPBarOffset</Name>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>DestroyObjectGroupOnDeath</Name>
          <Description>If object is dead, the complete object group is removed</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>OmitPamsyUponDestruction</Name>
          <Description>Indicates whether a pamsy should be triggered when this attackable is destroyed</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AccuracyWidth</Name>
          <Description>width of this object for accuracy calculations</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>DefenseByAIFactor</Name>
          <Description>how will the AI defend this? 0 - never defend, 100 - defend with normal calculation, 200 - defend with higher prio, even if 2:1 outnumbered</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MilitaryDefensePoints</Name>
          <Description>Used for the AI to determine how strong their fleet / harbour defense is and should be</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MilitaryAirDefensePoints</Name>
          <Description>Used for the AI to determine how strong their air fleet / harbour air defense is and should be</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>BlockBuildActionsAfterAttackDuration</Name>
          <Description>building actions: repair, move, destruct, upgrade are blocked after damaged by an attacker</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>MoralePower</Name>
          <Description>morale to prevent military takeover</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Asset</DataType>
          <Name>IslandWarFlag</Name>
          <Description>Morale buildings show flag when island war is active</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
          <Name>HasRuinState</Name>
          <Description>When buildings loose their last Hitpoints, they are change to ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticles</Name>
          <Description>The smoke particles that will be spawned during ruin state</Description>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>SmokeParticleFilePath</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticlesMin</Name>
          <Description>Min amount of smoke particles during ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticlesMax</Name>
          <Description>Max amount of smoke particles during ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>RuinSmokeParticleRectBorderPercent</Name>
          <Description>The smoke particles spawn on the whole building bounding box minus a border area - this value states how big of a percentage this border is on each of the 4 sides.</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffects</Name>
          <Description>When the building enters ruin state, one of the cfgs in here will be played</Description>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>ExplosionEffectFilePath</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffectsMin</Name>
          <Description>Min amount of explosion effects that will play on enter ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ExplosionEffectsMax</Name>
          <Description>Max amount of explosion effects that will play on enter ruin state</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>SelfHealPerHealTick</Name>
          <Description>building heals this amount of HP per Heal tick (currently 1 per second)</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Time</DataType>
          <Name>SelfHealPausedTimeIfAttacked</Name>
          <Description>building starts self repair after this time if not under attack anymore</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>OverrideAttackMarkerScale</Name>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>100</Max>
          <Description>When set to anything >0, will be used as the scale for the attack marker instead of the mesh bounding boxes scale</Description>
        </ValueDefinition>
      </Property>

Attacker.schema:
<Property>
        <Name>Attacker</Name>
        <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>BasicAttackType</Name>
          <DataSet>AttackType</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
          <Name>ShootingTracking</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <DataSet>ShootingTracking</DataSet>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>BaseDamage</Name>
          <Description>The amount of damage that is dealt within one ProjectileSalve. CAUTION: Exploding Projectiles do not use this value</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Min>0</Min>
          <Max>10000000</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>ReloadTime</Name>
          <Description>How many 100ms game ticks does it take to fire the next projectile?</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Integer</DataType>
          <Name>TargetAngleVariation</Name>
          <Description>how much can this ship variate his target angle without turning itself</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AttackRange</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>AttackRangeApproachPercentage</Name>
          <Description>Range percentage of attack radius at which ships will stop & shoot as well as at which shooting ships will start chasing away driving ships</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Max>1</Max>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>LineOfSightRange</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Float</DataType>
          <Name>MaxDistanceToPatrolRouteToBeAggressiveIn</Name>
          <Description>The maximum range we can be away from our patrol route to be able to start a passive attack. This helps to prevent use starting to attack an enemy when we are far away from our patrol route</Description>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>
          <DataType>Vector</DataType>
          <Name>Turrets</Name>
          <Category>Attacker</Category>
          <Items>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>TurnSpan</Name>
              <Description>Degrees (0 - 360), that the turrent can rotate (half to the left of its initial rotation, half to the right)</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>FileName</DataType>
              <Name>TurretCfg</Name>
              <Description>Config of the Turret (if none, no separate config will be spawned)</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Items>
        </ValueDefinition>
        <ValueDefinition>

BaseNotification.schema:
<Property>
                <Name>BaseNotification</Name>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>String</DataType>

                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Text</DataType>

                  <NeededProperty>Text;TextPool</NeededProperty>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>QuestGroup</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationTextGroup</Name>
                  <Description>The text group where the text is taken from. Any setting in NotificationText overwrites this one</Description>
                  <AssetConfig>AssetEditor</AssetConfig>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationBlockingTime</Name>
                  <Description>The time interval how often this notification is allowed to occur</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationAudioAsset</Name>
                  <Description>A sound that is played when the notification is triffereg (e.g. "Pling")</Description>

                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationPriority</Name>
                  <Description>The priority for the notification queue. A higher value means higher priority to be displayed. A value of -1 means it will never be blocked</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationMinDisplayTime</Name>
                  <Description>The minimum duration the notification will be actively displayed until it is discarded</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>NotificationGroup</Name>
                  <DataSet>NotificationGroup</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>DisplayTimeout</Name>
                  <Description>The amount of time the notification is queued without showing before it is deleted (or archived)</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>IsUnique</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether this notfication will not be queued, when a copy is already running or enqueued</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>RestrictToSessionOrRegion</Name>
                  <Description>Set to true if you want this notification only to be shown in a specific session or region. If the player is in a different session/region the notification will be postponed until the player enters the correct one. If you set this value then <DisplayTimeout> will be ignored. Handle with care!</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>RestrictedToSessionOrRegions</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>SessionOrRegion</Name>
                      <Description>The session or region where this notification may only be shown</Description>
                      <NeededProperty>Session;Region</NeededProperty>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Property>

Blocking.schema:

            <Name>Blocking</Name>

            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>

            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>

              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>GroundDecalInvisible</Name>
              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>

              <DataType>Asset</DataType>

              <Description>some building need three different ground plates, use this setting in that case</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>OverwriteGroundDecalWithRegionQuay</Name>
              <Description>If set to true the GroundDecal as well as the GroundDecalInvisible are replaced with the quay decals defined in the associated region asset.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>

              <DataType>Asset</DataType>
              <Name>StreetOutside</Name>

              <NeededProperty>Street</NeededProperty>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BuildDecalOutside</Name>
              <Description>true, if the ground decal should be placed outside of construction areas</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockWater</Name>
              <Description>should only be true for objects which are placed completly alone outside of island zones and cannot trap ships</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>RemoveFromWater</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>DisableBlockingByDefault</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockHarborFeedback</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HasBuildingBaseTiles</Name>
              <Description>BuildingBaseTiles will be build if dummies are configured</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HarbourAreaExpand</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>DisableDefaultTrafficFeedback</Name>
              <Description>If true, the feedback layer will not get stamped into the pathplanner. This is used for special feedback for e.g. farms where we dont want public traffic feedback but still need the feedback layer for specuial feedback.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>RemoveGrass</Name>
              <Description>You can disable the grass removal with this flag</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlocksBuilding</Name>
              <Description>if set to false, other buildings can be placed here. How the ovelap of the two objects is handled will be left to the developer</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>SuppressDangerToAnimals</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>BlockWhileInvisible</Name>
              <Description>Some systems ingore invisible blockers. Overwrite this behaviour.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>HasBuildableTilesBelowArch</Name>
              <Description>TLDR: Set True for gates. If this is true and our BuildBlocker is more complex then our BuildBlockerAABB, then all buildable tiles within AABB are only buildable for some other Buildings (see [BelowArchBuildHeight]). If false, those tiles are buildable for all buildings. This should be set to True for Gate-Buildings to prevent HugeOrnamentals or other Gate-Buildings to be built within. This should be false for L-shape buildings, as they can be intertwined without problems.</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>ArchHeight</Name>
              <Description>If [HasBuildableTilesBelowArch] is set, this value determines the height of the arch, so only tiles with a height lower or equal can be built below</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>OverwriteBelowArchBuildHeight</Name>
              <Description>If true, the height of this building (when checked against another Arch building (see [ArchHeight])) is not taken from CFG-BoundingBox, but overwritten with [BelowArchBuildHeight]</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Float</DataType>
              <Name>BelowArchBuildHeight</Name>
              <Description>See [ArchHeight] and [OverwriteBelowArchBuildHeight]</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ProvideLocalHeightForFeedbackLayer</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
              <Name>ProvideLocalHeightForStreetLayer</Name>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>HarbourAreaSize</Name>
              <Min>0</Min>
              <Max>10</Max>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Integer</DataType>
              <Name>AdditionalBlockRectSize</Name>
              <Description>the pathplanner update increases the update rect by this size to allow blockings outside of build blocker</Description>
            </ValueDefinition>
          </Property>

                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ContextAllowAny</Name>
                  <Description>If true, all counters will be summed up, ignoring the context</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>ComparisonOp</Name>
                  <Description>The comparison operator for counter value and desired value</Description>
                  <DataSet>ComparisonOperator</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Int64</DataType>

                  <Description>The desired value the counter should match</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>

                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>

                  <Description>Use the processing scope for this counter</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>

                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>

                  <Description>Indicates whether the session that is taken as context is the active session of the player</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                  <Name>CounterScopeContext</Name>
                  <Description>Context information for the counter scope, i.e. GUID of a region or session</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>CounterScopeKeepFirstFound</Name>
                  <Description>If true, the first time this condition gets evaluated and a scope context was found it will be kept forever (e.g. You don't know in which session this coindition will be started, but once it was started it should keep looking in that session). Otherwise the scope context will be checked continuously (e.g. You want to keep checking in the given session, used for quest preconditions for example)</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>RelativeToQuestStart</Name>
                  <Description>True: Counting from current condition start - False: Counting from 0.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShowAbsoluteValues</Name>
                  <Description>If RelativeToQuestStart is set, this value defines if absolute or relative values should be shown</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ShowInvertedValues</Name>
                  <Description>Indicates whether the player counter values shown in the questtracker should be inverted</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>CounterValueType</Name>
                  <Description>Defines if the MIN the MAX or the CURRENT value should be returned.</Description>
                  <DataSet>CounterValueType</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckSpecificParticipant</Name>
                  <Description>If true, not the condition owner will be checked but the participant that is specified under <CheckedParticipant></Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckedParticipant</Name>

                </ValueDefinition>

MilitaryAI.schema:
<Property>
            <Name>MilitaryAI</Name>
            <HasImplementation>1</HasImplementation>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>StrengthLevels</Name>
              <Description>Defines the overall behaviour of the AI for different states (superior, inferior, equal).</Description>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>Levels</Name>
                  <DataSet>MilitaryStrengthLevel</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxStrengthRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines the maximum strength ratio to be on this superiority level.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>Flee</Name>
                      <Description>Defines whether the AI should flee on this level.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>UniteUnits</Name>
                      <Description>Defines whether the AI should keep all of its units together.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxAttackRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used for attack purposes on this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxEscortRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used for escort purposes on this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxDefendRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used to defend yourself below this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxPatrolRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used for patrol purposes on this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxDefendAllyRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used to defend allies below this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxBombardRatio</Name>
                      <Description>Defines how many units should be used for bombard purposes on this superiority threshold.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>BudgetThreshold</Name>
                  <Description>The constructionAI contains military budgets that determine how much of the total budget may be used for military purposes. If the military strength of this AI is below this threshold, the AI considers itself to be threatened and will use the budget that is configured for this scenario.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>UpdateInterval</Name>
                  <Description>How often is the strength level recalculated</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Attack</Name>
              <Description>Contains several parameters used to run an attack.</Description>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MilitaryStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum strength ratio to run an attack.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>AdditionalUnitsRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Defines how strong should the AI be in the session to run an attack.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>AdditionalUnitsStrength</Name>
                  <Description>Min strength of available units used for aditional attacking units. Important for targets with a strength of 0 like buildings</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Defines intervals in which the AI will search for new targets (= attack frequency), Set to 0 if there should not be any targeted attacks. </Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AirAttackInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Same As AttackInterval, but for AirFleet</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackTargetPrio</Name>
                  <Description>Defines allowed targets and their priority (a target not listed here will only be attacked by auto attack)</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                      <Name>Targets</Name>
                      <DataSet>AITargetType</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                      <Name>Conditions</Name>
                      <Items>
                        <ValueDefinition>
                          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                          <Name>Condition</Name>
                          <DataSet>AttackCondition</DataSet>
                        </ValueDefinition>
                      </Items>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>SkipProbability</Name>
                      <Description>Usually the AI would always go with the first target in this list that it finds. This value describes the percental likeliness that this criterion is skipped to make the AI less predictable (0-100) ; 0 = never skip</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>SkipTargetWhenInHarbourArea</Name>
                      <Description>defines if the target should be skipped if it is within a harbour area when trying to find something to attack</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaximumConsideredTargets</Name>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>1000</Max>
                      <Description>(0 = consider all targets) The maximum amount of targets that will be considered for this priority. The targets are sorted based on the condition given</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                  <Name>IsBlinded</Name>
                  <Description>[Currently only supports one flag at a time] if an AI is "blinded" it cannot see any enemy ships and/or buildings when they come close, they can only fight back after getting attacked</Description>
                  <DataSet>MilitaryBlindedFlags</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>OwnedShareThreshold</Name>
                  <Description> If the AI owns at least this many shares of an island, it won't actively attack it anymore (currently we got a max amount of 5 shares)</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>RallyBeforeAttack</Name>
                  <Description>Defines if the AI makes its units group up before launching an attack</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>OverkillAttackThreshold</Name>
                  <Description>if the attack target and it's surroundings are at least this much of the entire military strength of the target participant IN THE CURRENT SESSION, then the AI will send an overkill attack. Otherwise it will scale down its fleets and only send as much as necessary. (0 -100)</Description>
                  <Min>0</Min>
                  <Max>100</Max>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Bombard</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>BombardPropagandaTargets</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetGUID</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetPriority</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>BombardCarePackageTargets</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetGUID</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>TargetPriority</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>BombDrops</Name>
                  <DataSet>ProgressLevel</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>IsActive</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>DesiredDamage</Name>
                      <Description>The amount of damage the bomb run should do if it hits all projectiles on one building.</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>DropCooldown</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>PropagandaDrops</Name>
                  <DataSet>ProgressLevel</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>IsActive</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxFleetSize</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>ShaftFillPercentage</Name>
                      <Description>0 to 100</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>DropIntervalMin</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>DropIntervalMax</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>CarePackageDrops</Name>
                  <DataSet>ProgressLevel</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>IsActive</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaxFleetSize</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>
                      <Name>ShaftFillPercentage</Name>
                      <Description>0 to 100</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>DropIntervalMin</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Time</DataType>
                      <Name>DropIntervalMax</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Defend</Name>
              <Description>Contains several parameters used for defending own buildings/ships</Description>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum strength ratio trying to match for defend groups</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>AdditionalUnits</Name>
                  <Description>Defines how many units will be added to a defend group.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>DefendInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Defines intervals in which the AI will search for points it has to defend (= defend frequency)</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>AirDefendInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Same as DefendInterval, but for AirFleet</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>AttackStrongestTargetFirst</Name>
                  <Description>Defines whether the AI should try to attack the strongest targets first.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>SharedDefendUnits</Name>
                  <Description>Defines whether the AI uses every available unit to attack the best target.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>ItemUsage</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum strength ratio to use an item.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>ItemUsageInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the interval how often the AI looks to use an item.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Patrol</Name>
              <Description>Contains several parameters used to send a squad on patrol.</Description>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinSize</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum size of a military patrol.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MaxSize</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the maximum size of a military patrol.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckPatrolInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Interval to check for new patrols or update existing ones.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckAirPatrolInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Same as CheckPatrolInterval, but for AirFleet</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>RandomRadius</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinDistanceToLand</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum distance to land for patrol stations (in tiles).</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                  <Name>UseStrategicPosition</Name>
                  <Description>Defines whether the squad will move to a strategic position instead of a patrol station...</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>SquadLogic</Name>
              <Description>Handles support, flee, and attack behaviour for ship squads</Description>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>FleeStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>100 = enemy strength. If our squad has this value or less strength relative to the enemy, start to flee</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>BombardFleeStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Like FleeStrengthRatio, but when bombarding</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>TargetPriorities</Name>
                  <Description>Attack: No need to flee, objects in range will be attacked according to this priority list</Description>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                      <Name>Targets</Name>
                      <DataSet>AITargetType</DataSet>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>Range</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MinStrengthRatio</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                      <Name>Conditions</Name>
                      <Items>
                        <ValueDefinition>
                          <DataType>Choice</DataType>
                          <Name>Condition</Name>
                          <DataSet>AttackCondition</DataSet>
                        </ValueDefinition>
                      </Items>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>SkipTargetWhenInHarbourArea</Name>
                      <Description>defines if the target should be skipped if it is within a harbour area when trying to find something to attack</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>MaximumConsideredTargets</Name>
                      <Description>(0 = consider all targets) The maximum amount of targets that will be considered for this priority. The targets are sorted based on the condition given</Description>
                      <Min>0</Min>
                      <Max>1000</Max>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                  <Name>CommandsToSupport</Name>
                  <Description>Support: Defines which commands are more important than the squad's command</Description>
                  <DataSet>AISquadCommands</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                  <Name>CommandsToAbandon</Name>
                  <Description>Support: Defines which commands might be abandoned in favour of supporting other fleets</Description>
                  <DataSet>AISquadCommands</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Float</DataType>
                  <Name>ObservationRange</Name>
                  <Description>General: The range around the center of the squad that is used to find things to support, flee from things, and attack things</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckSquadLogicInterval</Name>
                  <Description>General: How frequently the squadLogic is executed</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Escort</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinSize</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the minimum size of a military patrol.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MaxSize</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the maximum size of a military patrol.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MinStrengthRatio</Name>
                  <Description>Min Strength ratio of trade ship attackers.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckEscortInterval</Name>
                  <Description>Interval to check whether there are any trade ships to escort.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckAirEscortInterval</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>MaxEscapeDistance</Name>
                  <Description>Defines the distance how far an escort ship should move far away from its protected ship.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>Priorities</Name>
                  <DataSet>AIShipPurpose</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>Value</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>Repair</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>HPRatioCombat</Name>
                  <Description>How much HP should a unit have while being in combat to start a repair command.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                  <Name>HPRatioIdle</Name>
                  <Description>How much HP should a unit have while being in idle state to start a repair command.</Description>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Time</DataType>
                  <Name>CheckRepairInterval</Name>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>SquadPriorities</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Array</DataType>
                  <Name>Commands</Name>
                  <DataSet>AISquadCommands</DataSet>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>Priority</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                  </Items>
                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Flags</DataType>
                  <Name>CanQuitAndChangeSession</Name>
                  <DataSet>AISquadCommands</DataSet>
                </ValueDefinition>
              </Items>
            </ValueDefinition>
            <ValueDefinition>
              <DataType>Struct</DataType>
              <Name>WarFleet</Name>
              <Items>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
                  <Name>ShipList</Name>
                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Asset</DataType>
                      <Name>Type</Name>
                    </ValueDefinition>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Float</DataType>

                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>

                  <DataType>Struct</DataType>
                  <Name>CatchupFactor</Name>

                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>
                      <Name>Enabled</Name>
                      <Description>enable shiplimit catchup</Description>

                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>

                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Struct</DataType>
                  <Name>SlowdownFactor</Name>

                  <Items>
                    <ValueDefinition>
                      <DataType>Boolean</DataType>

                      <Description>enable shiplimit slowdown</Description>

                      <DataType>Integer</DataType>
                      <Name>SlowdownToPercentage</Name>
                      <Description>how much of the human ship count should AI slow down to</Description>
                    </ValueDefinition>

            <ValueDefinition>

                    </ValueDefinition>

                        <ValueDefinition>
                          <DataType>Integer</DataType>

                </ValueDefinition>
                <ValueDefinition>
                  <DataType>Vector</DataType>
